items.title: Arthur Vigne Interview, 1961-11-29
items.q: His nephew was taking care of him by the name of Williams.

ctx.x: Three years ago. The son huh?

No, it was the old man. His son wasn't even living here. His nephew was taking care of him by the name of Williams. His son I think was up north some place and they had to send for his relatives when he died. So it wouldn't have been the old man that would have played with your father. I mean old man Glennie, they always called him old man Glennie. He was about 88 years old.
Well that's the old man, he was a bass player.
